_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Only saying very good or very bad

segments.text: It means, it is pretty good.
How was the movie? Not bad!

native.caption: Her şeye “very good” demekten sıkıldın mı? “Not bad.” yani fena değil, günlük konuşmada çok doğal. Örnek: “How was the movie?” – “Not bad!” Ama öğretmeni dinle, sessizlikte tekrar et. Lexkite uygulamasında devam et.

en.hook: How do you say "not bad" in English?
en.caption: Tired of saying “very good” about everything? “Not bad.” means pretty good and sounds natural in conversation. Example: “How was the movie?” – “Not bad!” Listen to Ama, then repeat in the pause. Keep going in the Lexkite app.
